text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's strange...? I could have sworn I 
heard a voice...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the Three Goddesses statue... Could 
it really be them?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why... Even though there's no way 
that could be true, it really feels like 
it is.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Goddesses, if you have something to 
say, I'd love to hear it. Tell me first!
